summary: This is a configuration file that describes a tool for automatically generating pull-request descriptions. It tells the tool to look at what code changed between a base branch (defaulting to main) and the current branch, then create a summary explaining why those changes were made and what was modified.

explanations.3: This tells users they can optionally specify which branch to compare against when running this tool; if they don't provide one, it uses 'main' by default.
explanations.4: This declares which commands the tool is allowed to run — it can execute git diff and git log commands, plus read files.
explanations.9: This is the instruction for what the tool should actually do: examine the git changes and history, then write a one-paragraph explanation of why the changes exist followed by a bullet-point list of what changed — but skip the test plan section unless test files were modified.
